_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The context usage popup lists subagents in the breakdown and includes them in the total. The screen is 1280x900, the page's clock is fake (window.__clock; time flows until fastForward), and every model costs $10 per million tokens of each kind. The server reports the conversation's subagents as one model "review-model" with 9 calls costing $55.161; later it reports $60. Call "mark" remembers how many times the page has asked for subagent usage so far; call "asked since mark" returns "true" if the page has asked again since, else "false"; call "hold" makes the server hold every later subagent usage request instead of answering it, and also marks like "mark"; call "release" switches the cost to $60, stops holding, answers the held request (it fails if none is held) and waits until it has been answered. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and click ".context-usage-label". 2. data-testid "subagent-cost-row" ("the subagent row") should be visible (allow 30s) and contain "$55.16". 3. data-testid "token-cost-total" ("the total") should be visible and contain "Total", and its "th" should have computed border-top-style "solid". 4. A ".token-cost-graph-note" containing "main conversation only" should be visible. 5. Poll eval window.__subagentLayout() (the page already defines it; do not define it yourself) until it returns exactly {"totalAboveSubtotal":true,"subtotalAboveModels":true,"graphWide":true,"graphAsWideAsTable":true,"titleAlignedWithGraph":true,"costsAligned":true} (it measures the popup's boxes all at once, as the popup moves on a later frame after it is resized for the subagents). 6. Call "hold". 7. Eval window.__clock.fastForward(5000). 8. Call "asked since mark" until it returns "true", then call "mark". 9. Eval window.__clock.fastForward(15000), then call "asked since mark": it must return "false" (no second poll while one is outstanding). 10. Call "release". 11. The subagent row should contain "$60.00". The ".token-cost-model-breakdown" containing "review-model" should contain "6.0M" and "$60.00". 12. Call "mark". Click ".context-usage-label": the total should be hidden. Click ".context-usage-label" again: the total should be visible. 13. Call "asked since mark" until it returns "true" (reopening asks again).

steps.expression: (function() { var r = window.__subagentLayout(); var expected = {totalAboveSubtotal:true,subtotalAboveModels:true,graphWide:true,graphAsWideAsTable:true,titleAlignedWithGraph:true,costsAligned:true}; for (var k in expected) { if (r[k] !== expected[k]) return 'MISMATCH:' + k + '=' + r[k]; } for (var k in r) { if (!(k in expected)) return 'EXTRA:' + k; } return 'ok'; })()
